analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session E) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), transitions sheet (3 boundaries, every 2nd frame), listen sheet (16 accents) and a 30 fps strip at 2.85-3.30 s (ffmpeg backend). Boundary-accent offsets from measure_batch5.py. nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 15.0 s (1280x720, 30 fps); the bloom at 30 fps, other boundaries at 15 fps.

concept.observed: Promotes a referral programme for a mascot-making product: 'tell a friend' is struck and corrected to the whole group chat, the product is shown making a mascot from a prompt, the cut of each sale is stated, a slider shows what referrals could earn, and the end card offers the deal.
concept.interpreted: Each claim is shown as an action: strike, type, drag.

communication_style.observed: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music. Bold grotesk headlines with the payoff words in orange.

palette.observed: White and off-white (#f8f8f8, 79%), pastel pink discs, vibrant orange (button, stickers, payoff words), charcoal type, one black panel for the earnings figure.

typography.observed: Heavy grotesk headlines (about 6-8% of the height) with the second half in orange; tilted sticker labels; large tabular dollar figures.

composition.observed: Opening headline centred; later headlines left at about 35-45% of the height with a 3D mascot right on a pink disc; a calculator card left and a black result panel right (9.2-12.3 s).

motion.observed: The headline builds word by word (0.38-1.1 s); a strike crosses 'a friend' and a tilted sticker stamps below (1.62-1.82 s); a prompt types and a button is clicked (4.1-5.6 s); stickers stamp at 8.17-8.27 s and 11.18-11.28 s; a slider drags and the figure rolls $500 -> $5,000 (9.3-11.0 s); a cursor clicks the call to action (13.7-13.9 s).

transitions.observed: 3 boundaries, 0 cuts. 3.03 s: grow, a small orange dot in the headline (2.85 s) blooms to cover the frame by 3.02 s (0.17 s), then a white hole opens in it and clears by 3.18 s (0.16 s). 9.07 s: continuous, a 0.15 s dissolve (8.95-9.10 s) with a thin orange frame. 12.30 s: cover, one white diagonal edge sweeps across in about 0.12 s. Not detected: at 6.1-6.5 s the mascot slides out left and the next headline fades in.
transitions.interpreted: The bloom starts from a dot already in the headline, so the change feels caused.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Sections of 3.0, 3.1, 3.0, 3.2 and 2.7 s; stamps and counter steps between them.

sound_design.observed: -21.0 LUFS (quiet), LRA 2.2 LU, true peak -1.8 dBTP. Tempo 73.8 bpm (medium). 17 accents (68/min). Accents on boundaries 2/3 within 100 ms (chance 0.20); all 3 within 103 ms, the sound 60-103 ms before the picture (2.93 vs 3.03 s, 8.99 vs 9.07 s, 12.24 vs 12.30 s); onsets on boundaries 1.0 (chance 0.50), on a beat 0.67 (chance 0.15). Other accents: the sticker stamps (1.72, 8.27, 11.28 s), the counter steps (9.36, 10.45, 10.87, 11.01 s) and the call-to-action click (13.72 s). No silences. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Here the transitions are events (a bloom, a dissolve, a sweep) and get the hit, slightly early.

narration.observed: None: 9 raw words, 0 confident. Engine Windows desktop dictation (System.Speech en-US), rough.

captions.observed: No captions; copy is headlines (1-2 lines, 3-7 words, held about 3 s, payoff in orange) and sticker labels (3-5 words) stamped beside them.

scenes.observed: Headline builds; 'a friend' is struck; the sticker says the whole group chat.
Mascots for their product: prompt, click, a 3D mascot appears.
A cut of every credit: two mascots, the '20% for life' sticker.
What could you earn: the slider drags and the figure rolls to $5,000.
End card: the deal and a clicked call to action.

moments.observed: A dot in the headline grows to a full orange cover by 3.02 s, then a white hole opens and clears it by 3.18 s; the accent at 2.93 s lands as the dot starts to grow.

difficult: The 3D mascots are rendered characters (pre-rendered stills or plates)
uncertainties: Whether the boundary accents are effects or the music's own hits
The quiet -21 LUFS level may be the export, not a choice
